title: Pushing and Pulling
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Outside, in pairs and small teams, on soft ground. Counting while pushing and pulling links to Mathematics.

skills.key_step: The child tells pushing (away from the body) from pulling (towards the body) in games and at home, and pushes and pulls safely.

floor.prerequisite: Moves the body in named directions (Grade 2).
floor.question: Turn to your right. Which way did you turn?

representations: a chair or a box to move
steps: Is it coming towards you or going away?
Say one safety rule for the game.
contexts: tug of war at games time
fetching water and moving a wheelbarrow at home

board.say: Is the chair coming to me or going away?

board.do: So is it a push or a pull?

misconceptions.ask: A girl brings a bucket of water up from a well with a rope. Is she pushing or pulling?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: is the bucket coming towards her or going away from her?

misconceptions.ask: A boy moves a wheelbarrow in front of him. Is he pushing or pulling?
misconceptions.repair: Push a chair across the floor, then pull it, and say where the chair is each time.

misconceptions.ask: In tug of war, what do the two teams do with the rope?
misconceptions.repair: Hold a rope with a partner and pull it gently towards yourself.

misconceptions.ask: In a pulling game, what is the safe way to pull?
misconceptions.repair: Show how a sudden jerk makes a partner fall, using a soft toy.

checks.question: A girl closes a door by moving it away from her. Push or pull?
Which game is a pulling game: tug of war or wheelbarrow race?
